item.title: EplayerX 1.2.8
item.description:
## 更新日志
- 改进 Jellyfin 下载的多版本选择，展示更完整的资源信息。 - 优化批量下载选集，支持跨季保留勾选，并跳过已完成的下载。 - 改进云盘、网络共享与 Plex 的播放信息和续播处理。 - 提升音频输出、流媒体缓存恢复和播放器关闭时的稳定性。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本，请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What's New
- Improved version selection for Jellyfin downloads with more complete media information. - Improved batch episode downloads, preserving selections across seasons and skipping completed downloads. - Improved playback metadata and resume handling for cloud drives, network shares, and Plex. - Improved stability of audio output, streaming cache recovery, and player shutdown.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
